**Where is it?**
Page URL, and the sentence or figure if you can.

**What is wrong?**

**What lets us re-check it?**
A link, a document, a calculation, a transaction id. Corrections that come
with checkable evidence can be acted on immediately; ones that do not have to
wait until the evidence is found.

If the problem is that published material identifies a private individual,
please email info@cc-vuln.org instead of opening a public issue.
